text.content:
A yakuza family of Bunny Exotics that the Claws walk around.

Turf: One quiet block of Japantown, in the middle of Claw territory
Known for: Biomedical engineering, bodysculpting, and the Tsukimi Exotic conversion
Leadership: Harumi Usagi, the oyabun
Allies & rivals: Patron: Japanese executives nobody will name. Enemies: nobody who has said so twice
Hangouts: The Moon Garden, a private clinic and teahouse off Jig-Jig Street

After the Purge-Riot every yakuza family in Night City joined the Tyger Claws or disappeared, all but the Usagi. They are a yakuza family in the old sense, with an oyabun, oaths and a family name every member takes, and every member, without exception, is a Bunny Exotic: long ears, soft fur in white, grey or moon-silver, and immaculate kimono or black suits.

On paper they are a Tokyo-registered biomedical firm, and they guard the family trade the way older families guarded their gambling halls. They hold the patent on their own Exotic conversion, the Tsukimi, lighter, quieter and far better than Biotechnica's LagoForm, and sold to nobody outside the family. The Moon Garden's surgeons are some of the best in the city and will work on outsiders, for a price and a favor.

The Claws tried to absorb them in 2048 and in 2056. Both times the Claw boss who gave the order was dead within a week of something medical: a heart that stopped, chrome his body suddenly rejected. Since then the Claws walk around the Moon Garden. Twice a year the Usagi are visited by Japanese executives who never give their names.

GM secrets

Doc Mags has seen one Tsukimi conversion up close, after a car wreck. The nerve work in the ears is better than anything in Biotechnica's catalog or hers; somebody has been doing this for a lot longer than the Usagi admit. If their patrons are Arasaka, nobody can say why Arasaka let its own dogs bite twice. If they aren't, nobody knows who scares the Claws more than Arasaka does.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 09
